- The cutover moved to **Sunday 22/11, 02:00–04:00 UTC**: Fernhill's month-end batch runs Saturday night until ~06:00 UTC. Maya told the CSMs; update the runbook (and the Notion page, which still says Saturday) [8][10].

## What you did

- You rehearsed the whole blue/green on a snapshot clone: 74 s of write downtime, API reconnected through pgbouncer, no data mismatch — then tore the clone down [1].
